title: lean4-review-input/v2
description: Hook INPUT contract (Issue #115) — the context /lean4:review sends to custom hooks on stdin. Plain Draft-2020-12 (not Codex-consumed, so not bound by OpenAI Structured Outputs). Lenient: existing callers that omit the new repo-state fields still validate; repository_kind / contributing_upstream reuse the project-context/v1 vocabulary verbatim.

repository_kind.description: Repository kind, reusing project-context/v1's enum verbatim. Kept separate from contribution intent.

contributing_upstream.description: Contribution intent, from project-context/v1. Separate from repository_kind.

new_files.description: .lean files added in the current review candidate set.

generated_root_files.description: Generated root-import files that may need `lake exe mk_all` after add/rename/delete, e.g. ["Mathlib.lean"].
